training: B, T and natural killer cells
validation: Held-out source populations. Joint donor tasks also withhold source donors.
test: Myeloid responses. Pooled cell-type transfer shares donors. Joint donor–cell-type transfer additionally withholds the target donor.
normalization_and_features: Log1p CPM of summed profile counts across the released 5317-gene panel
evaluation_scope: Development study; shared donors in pooled cell-type transfer, separate joint donor/type holdouts

test: Four primary-cell populations: blood progenitors, CD8 T cells, bronchial epithelial cells and preadipocytes
evaluation_scope: Development study; cultured source populations refitted within study

training: Lymphoid cells from seven donors per fold
validation: Source-only donor and cell-type validation, or a rule fixed in OP3
test: Two monocyte populations from the eighth donor, repeated across eight donors
normalization_and_features: Per-cell log1p CP10k using complete raw libraries, then condition means; source-control 2000-gene selection
evaluation_scope: Independent experiment with within-study source fitting; OP3 rule-transfer variant keeps reliability parameters fixed

training: Seven lymphoid populations from eleven donors per fold
validation: Joint source donor and cell-type holdouts
test: CD14 and CD16 monocytes from the held-out donor, across twelve donor folds
normalization_and_features: Per-cell log1p CP10k using recomputed complete raw libraries, then condition means; source-control 2000-gene selection
evaluation_scope: Independent cytokine experiment with source fitting; inspected in subsequent model development

training: Five lymphoid populations from the other five donors in the same batch
validation: Joint source donor and cell-type holdouts using the parameter grid fixed in Parse
test: Held-out donor monocytes, with batch-specific stimulus panels and pilot budgets
normalization_and_features: Per-cell log1p CP10k using complete raw libraries for pilot tasks; separate 14748-gene denominator for native Stack comparison
evaluation_scope: Independent experiment; fixed pilot protocol with within-study source refitting. Native Stack weights are pretrained and frozen

training: Lowest and highest doses in three cell lines
validation: A fixed fraction of endpoint-dose source cells
test: Two intermediate doses in the same three cell lines, giving 54 conditions
normalization_and_features: Released processed expression, first 512 genes used as a common fixed panel
evaluation_scope: Dose development evaluation within known cells and drugs; same original study as sci-Plex2

test: Seven eligible conditions at 5 or 50 µM
normalization_and_features: Count-summed hash profiles transformed by log1p CPM; 32418 source-supported response genes
evaluation_scope: Dose evaluation within known cells and drugs; six interpolated and one extrapolated conditions

validation: T98G for selection. Separate A172 conditions for interval calibration.
normalization_and_features: Released log-normalised expression; 512 genes selected excluding U87MG but potentially including T98G validation data
evaluation_scope: Previously inspected U87MG development evaluation; low drug-effect repeatability at fine condition resolution

test: Drug-treated responses of 27 held-out genes, with their vehicle responses available as inputs
normalization_and_features: Count-summed guide-condition profiles transformed by log1p CPM; 26357 source-supported response genes
evaluation_scope: Development split; observed vehicle response for evaluation genes is permitted

training: Two donors, each with resting and two activated states
test: A fourth donor in the same three states
normalization_and_features: Count-summed donor-target-state profiles transformed by log1p CPM; focused immune-regulator panel
evaluation_scope: Focused cross-donor evaluation within known activation states; 12 common targets and 35 test conditions

normalization_and_features: Log1p CPM of bulk wells after excluding external RNA spike-ins; 18986 source-supported human genes
evaluation_scope: Auxiliary bulk experiment; 258 same-dose and 114 differing-dose compounds; limited drug-response repeatability
